summary: President of New York Life Insurance & Trust; John's 4th cousin 7x removed.
bio:
Married Julia Tyler's first cousin Sarah Diodati Gardiner; their son Frederick Diodati Thompson held Sagtikos Manor.

Eldest son of Jonathan Thompson ([R4-S1]): 4th cousin 7 times removed via John Thompson, 5th cousin 6 times removed via Bull Smith. Married Sarah Diodati Gardiner; children Sarah G. (Mrs Col. David Lion Gardiner), Elizabeth, Gardiner, David Gardiner, Charles Griswold, Mary Gardiner and Frederick Diodati (proprietor of Sagtikos Manor in 1898).
sources: [R4-S1] W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. p. 470 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/recordsoftownofs00smitrich
